mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within three months indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) by more than 5% over three months signals a strong demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the correlation between HOUST increases and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over two months signals a contraction in supply, which leads to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances when FEDFUNDS is below 1%, or the correlation between low FEDFUNDS and positive 5-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% each within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 0.5% and UNRATE decrease > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the joint correlation between the specified changes in PAYEMS and UNRATE and positive 20-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decrease in real disposable personal income (RSAFS) by more than 1% over two months during a period of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals reduced consumer purchasing power, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decrease > 1% in 2 months when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the correlation between the specified changes in RSAFS and CPIAUCSL and negative 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous increase in GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% each within a quarter signals a shift towards service-based economic growth, which is less capital-intensive and thus supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 1% and INDPRO decrease > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or the joint correlation between the specified changes in GDPC1 and INDPRO and positive 60-day returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
